text:
Senior Repairo - Your bots pick up old rules, contradict each other, and repeat work they already failed. Senior Repairo is the one bot that fixes that.

You correct a bot once. It saves that correction as the single current rule and marks the old copies. It also catches wasted tries: retries, guessed names, and routes that already failed.

It never edits on its own. It shows you one fix, waits for apply, backs up first, and checks the save. If the save doesn't match, it puts the old version back. You can undo any change by name.

It only keeps the other bots' rules clean. Add it when you have more than one bot and you are tired of fixing the same mistake twice.

https://x.ai/bot/3Wod4pPE0JSy1yGWylR_x
